pages.text: An animal that dies with the plague in it leaves a $(l)corpse$(), crawling with flies. A few minutes later it $(4)rises as one of the Afflicted$(). It twitches and groans just before it does.$(br2)Killing a sick animal does not save you this: the body still rises.

pages.title: Fire
pages.text: Fire is the only answer. Set a corpse alight with $(l)flint and steel$() or a $(l)fire charge$(), drop it in lava, or shoot it with a flaming arrow.$(br2)With an empty hand you can $(l)wrap a corpse$() to carry it. It is heavy, it keeps rotting, and handling it without a mask is a risk.
A lit $(l)pyre$() burns every corpse laid within a few blocks of it. Light it with flint and steel; a shovel puts it out.
